Figure 30 Forgot Password Front-end Sequence Diagram 
An important feature to note within Figure 30, is after a user creates a new 
password request, if the account name is invalid, the toast shown to the user 
will display a randomised spoof email. This strategy attempts to hide real 
usernames and emails from hackers, thereby enhancing the applications 
security. Another critical aspect is there is no-limit to the number of times a user 
can change their password, since the developer thought that limiting this could 
potentially pose as a security threat.
